items.title: What Does GoDaddy Offer That Akamai Does Not?
items.summary: Akamai Technologies (AKAM) and GoDaddy (GDDY) are both bought to capture the same trend: businesses paying for AI over the internet. Akamai sells the computing power for AI through its cloud infrastructure services. GoDaddy sells its AI tools, called Airo, to the small businesses that already buy its domains. One company is building new capacity, while the other sells from a platform it already runs. What did each company tell the market in its latest report.
